scenarios.description: Open the T3 destination picker with Down as soon as the recording pill presents it.
scenarios.userEntryPoint: Finish an eligible recording with Send recordings to T3 Code enabled, then press Down without clicking the pill.
prerequisites: Build the Desktop frontend and run its test:pill suite in a graphical session. The smoke test uses a loopback catalogue and an isolated profile.
expectedEvidence: The admitted window and destination control receive keyboard focus. Down opens thread search, Escape restores focus to the collapsed control, and Down or typing can open it again.
The Linux replacement stays hidden until its exact window ID is activated by the parent, and the outgoing window is hidden before the replacement shows.
With the outer viewport constrained during expansion, Down moves the option selection without scrolling the pill header out of view.
A visible Hyprland picker keeps its native height and updates its input shape after the collapsed layout paints. Reopening before paint discards the stale shape.
limits: The smoke test runs the production Electron host and renderer with a synthetic native parent. A real capture and compositor-specific focus require native verification.

scenarios.description: Measure picker input to a selectable destination and selection to a verified T3 receipt and Submitted presentation.
scenarios.userEntryPoint: Open the destination picker on a completed recording, then select an existing thread.
prerequisites: Manual performance-benchmark workflow on standard GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 with published full revision SHAs.
Dedicated hosted CPU accounting with unrelated load, guest steal, throttling and I/O below the focused benchmark thresholds.
expectedEvidence: A trusted click, a selectable row, the exact synthetic dispatch payload, an independent receiver acceptance, the durable sent receipt and the visible Submitted indicator.
Separate fresh and prewarmed catalogue trials, normalized score, matched repeat deltas, CPU, PSS, storage, interference and span attribution.
limits: Runs the production Electron renderer and Handoff code with a synthetic native parent and loopback T3 receiver. Real clipboard, native compositor, OS focus restoration and real T3 acceptance require their existing verification lanes.
